title: Minimum Nautical Gap Between Islands
description:
You are given an n x m grid where 1 represents land and 0 represents water. An island is a 4-directionally connected group of 1s. The grid contains exactly two islands.

Your goal is to connect these two islands by changing the minimum possible number of 0s into 1s. Return the minimum number of water cells that must be converted to bridge the gap.
input_format:
The first line contains two integers n and m, representing the row and column dimensions of the grid.
The next n lines each contain m space-separated integers (0 or 1).
output_format: Print the minimum number of flips required to connect the two islands.
constraints:
2 <= n, m <= 100
The grid contains exactly two islands.
